title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: “tidiers” VAR models tidyvars designed integrate vars package tidyverse ecosystem: introduces “tidiers” simplify analysis Vector Autoregressive (VAR) Models, following “tidy data” philosophy. package makes VAR modelling accessible intuitive, especially old users broom.

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: Choosing tidyvars working VAR Models offers key advantages: 1. Efficient Data Handling: tidyvars converts VAR outputs “tidy format” simplifying data manipulation. 2. Tidyverse Integration: tidyvars ensures smooth interoperability famous tools, like dplyr ggplot2. 3. Enhanced Interpretability: tidyvars significantly eases understanding interpretation model results.

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: Effortlessly manipulate, summarize, augment VAR models using tv_tidy(), tv_glance(), tv_augment(): tidyvars functions begins tv_*() maintain suffix found vars package consistency. evaluate model’s adherence standard parametric assumptions use tv_normality_test() tv_serial_test(): delve deeper causal relationships, see tv_causality(): VAR models specially useful forecasting given ability capture interdependencies multiple time series. tidyvars, task easily accomplished tv_predict(): nuanced inferences relationships model, use tv_fevd() tv_irf(): functions tv_fevd() tv_irf() particularly useful understanding shocks one variable might propagate system impact variables time.

title: Extends broom for VAR models
text: tidyvars integrates autoplot() method functions enhance user experience quick intuitive visual representation model outputs. See examples bellow:
code: # Fitted Model autoplot(tv_augment(mod)) # Visualizes Impulse Response Functions autoplot(tv_irf(mod)) # Displays Forecast Error Variance Decomposition autoplot(tv_fevd(mod)) # Generates visual forecasts autoplot(tv_predict(mod, n.ahead = 12))
